title: Gulshane panjetan ko loot liya
body:
Gulshane panjetan ko loot liya
Ek ghareebul watan ko loot liya
Koofiyo'n ne bula ke dhoke se
Haaye shaahe zaman ko loot liya
<<DIVIDER>>
Kalma padh padh ke haaye ummat ne
Mustafa ke chaman ko loot liya
Karke paamaal laashae qasim
Ek shab ki dulhan ko loot liya
<<DIVIDER>>
Laashe akber utha ke sheh bole
Mere sheeree'n suqan ko loot liya
Khaali jhoola jhula rahi hai maa
Uske ghuncha dahan ko loot liya
<<DIVIDER>>
Ek bhai ko zib'ha kar daala
Ek bekas behen ko loot liya
Dashte ghurbat me cheen li chaadar
Zainabe qastatan ko loot liya
